entries.title: Initial working draft
entries.summary: First public working draft of the proposed domains, shared definitions, and draft JSON Schemas. Nothing in this draft is stable; every definition is open for review and may change without notice.
added: Shared definitions (common.schema.json): Identifier, Money, Date, Address, StrataPlanNumber, ParcelIdentifier, Extensions.
Core Strata Entities: StrataCorporation, StrataPlan, Building, StrataLot, CommonProperty, Unit, Person, Organization, OwnershipInterest.
Governance: StrataCouncil, CouncilMember, GeneralMeeting, CouncilMeeting, Resolution, VotingRecord, Bylaw.
Financial Management: Fund, Budget, Levy, FinancialTransaction.
Maintenance and Assets: CommonAsset, MaintenanceRequest, WorkOrder.
Illustrative example payload for every drafted entity, validated against its schema at build time.
entries.migration: No migration is required. This is the first draft and there is no earlier version to migrate from.

openProposals.title: Ontario and Alberta condominium jurisdiction profiles
openProposals.description: Add ON and AB to the jurisdiction vocabulary, with province-specific vocabularies and documents (for example status and estoppel certificates, reserve fund studies).

openProposals.title: Jurisdiction-neutral entity names
openProposals.description: Decide whether BC-specific names such as StrataCorporation and StrataLot should become neutral names (for example Corporation and Unit) with provincial labels, before the first stable release.

openProposals.title: Model sections (residential / non-residential) of a strata corporation
openProposals.description: Sections have their own budgets, bylaws and executives. Decide whether a Section entity is needed in 0.1 or deferred.

openProposals.title: Structured depreciation report
openProposals.description: Represent depreciation report components and funding scenarios as structured data rather than only as a Document.

openProposals.title: Account and FinancialStatement entities
openProposals.description: Agree on a minimal chart-of-accounts model that does not assume a particular accounting package.

openProposals.title: Individual vote records and privacy
openProposals.description: Decide whether per-lot votes belong in the standard or only aggregate tallies.
